# www.gemoraglobal.co

> Wholesale imitation jewellery manufacturer and exporter from Jaipur, India since 2011. Factory-direct B2B bulk supplier. MOQ 50 units. Exporting to USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, France & 30+ countries. 500+ designs with anti-tarnish coating.

## Core Hubs

* [Home](https://www.gemoraglobal.co): Official B2B portal of Gemora Global Private Limited. Sourcing imitation, Kundan, bridal, oxidized, and AD fashion jewellery directly from the Jaipur factory.
* [About Us](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/about): Factory history (Est. 2011), direct-to-retailer model, 3-stage strict quality control (QC), and anti-tarnish plating technologies.
* [Wholesale Enquiry](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/wholesale): Bulk quotation requests, custom OEM/ODM manufacturing, private label branding, packaging services, and tier-based wholesale B2B pricing.
* [Export Desk](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/export): International shipping details via DHL/FedEx, customs compliance documents (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin), and global logistics network serving 30+ countries.
* [Product Catalogues](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/catalogues): Instant download of seasonal digital wholesale catalogues, custom collection previews, and PDF order sheets.
* [Gallery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/gallery): Jaipur factory production lines, craftsmanship showcase, Kundan setting, hand-enameling, and real-time factory floor pictures.
* [FAQ](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/faq): Comprehensive B2B guidelines on minimum order quantities (MOQ), custom design lead times, payment terms, and global shipping fees.
* [Contact Us](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/contact): Instant WhatsApp direct link (+91 7976341419), business email (globalgemora@gmail.com), and Jaipur factory address for in-person showroom visits.
* [Why Choose Us](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/why-choose-us): Detailed breakdown of Jaipur manufacturing advantages, cost benefits, customization capabilities, and B2B shipping guarantees.

## Wholesale Categories & Collections

* [Earrings Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/earrings): Jaipur Jhumkas, Chandbalis, antique studs, lightweight daily wear hoops, and stone-studded ear chains.
* [Necklace Sets Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/necklaces): Premium Kundan chokers, gold-plated bridal necklace sets, minimalist layered chains, and royal antique collar sets.
* [Bracelets & Bangles Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/bracelets): Traditional hand-painted Meenakari bangles, stone-encrusted bracelets, oxidised silver cuff bracelets, and daily-wear stretch bracelets.
* [Rings Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/rings): Statement cocktail rings, stackable minimalist rings, Kundan adjustable rings, and premium AD stone rings.
* [Kundan Jewellery Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/kundan-jewelry): High-grade Kundan gemstones set in gold-foil, featuring classic Jaipur glass-stone setting and premium anti-tarnish backing.
* [Oxidised Silver Jewellery Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/oxidised-jewelry): Boho ethnic earrings, tribal necklaces, vintage rings, and silver-look daily wear jewelry.
* [Meenakari Jewellery Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/meenakari-jewelry): Traditional hand-enameling in vibrant colors on gold-plated and brass bases.
* [Antique Jewellery Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/antique-jewelry): Heritage style necklaces, dark gold-plated temple jewelry, and vintage royal Jaipur collections.
* [Gold Plated Jewellery Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/gold-plated-jewelry): 18k and 22k gold micro-plated necklaces, earrings, and chains with e-coat tarnish resistance.
* [Bridal Jewellery Wholesale](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/bridal-jewelry): Heavyweight wedding chokers, complete matha patti, nath, and bridal set matching combinations.
* [Daily Wear Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/daily-wear-jewelry): Lightweight necklaces, small studs, and simple bands designed for comfortable everyday use.
* [Minimalist Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/minimalist-jewelry): Sleek cubic zirconia pendants, delicate chains, and stackable simple rings.
* [Korean Style Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/korean-jewelry): Trendy pastel earrings, cute motif pendants, and minimal aesthetic accessories.
* [Party Wear Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/party-wear-jewelry): High-shine cubic zirconia cocktail chokers, chandelier earrings, and premium glamour cuffs.
* [Trendy Fashion Jewellery](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/trendy-jewelry): Season-first geometric earrings, multi-layered chain necklaces, and contemporary design accessories.
